title: Excellent tour of Barcelona
text: Excellent two hour tour with Thomas! We explored three markets, three church’s, and many neighborhoods. Excellent tour.

text: It was great, very informative, fun, a good balance of walking and talking. Alberto was engaging and funny, and I felt like I got a window into some lesser known parts of Barcelona lore.

title: Thomas was a great guide
text: Thomas was an excellent guide. Friendly and energetic. Helped us fulfill a request for passion fruit. Made the history fun and interesting.

title: Terrify Tour - . Markets and more!
text: Thomas was terrific ! !  He is a wonderful guide.  great personality, easy to hear and shared many interesting stories.
